text: In a an intense season of being betrayed, it's really a heartbreaking psalm. This is David. We've been tracking with him over four weeks now. We saw him in his twenties when he was at his best, hiding in caves, and yet people were trying to kill him, and he was praying to God. Then we saw last week after he became king at age thirty, makes an absolute mess of his life, and he then asked God for forgiveness, and God shows up with His mercy and His grace. Now this is later in David's life, and there's two people.
